problem: The shipped sample factory.toml omits the [hooks] section (main_session_wall, log_retention_days, rules) although the spec example claims to be the whole key list. The loader fills the defaults, so nothing breaks, but the sample is no longer a full illustration of the key table.
proposed_resolution: Have E1 regenerate the sample factory.toml from config.SPECS when the [hooks] keys settle, or add the [hooks] block to the sample by hand.

where: next/plugins/vsdd-factory/py/vsdd/policy/artifacts.toml (placeholder rows: module-map, dependencies, toolchain, holdout-evaluation, demo-evidence, review-report, design-system, asset)
problem: Placeholder registry rows carry no max_bytes cell and a string frontmatter cell, so check_text silently applies no size cap and no frontmatter check to those kinds (for example .factory/specs/architecture/dependencies.toml passes validation at any size), while topic:artifact-rules states every file has a size cap checked before the write.
proposed_resolution: The packages that ship those kinds (the G series) must give the rows real glob, id, frontmatter and max_bytes cells; until then, test_policy pins the placeholder state, so the waiver is explicit and tested.

problem: git status --porcelain collapses untracked directories (?? stories/), so a caller that forgets -uall gets directory names whose files it cannot then read. The shipped helper now passes -uall, but nothing binds future callers to it.
proposed_resolution: Note the -uall requirement in topic:state-commits when flush is specified, or move the flag behind a named helper so callers never open-code the status call.

problem: init checks the git identity before detect(), so a project mid-setup gets the identity error even when it would have taken the ready/idempotent path, which writes nothing; the two error orders can disagree about which problem a broken environment reports first.
proposed_resolution: If a later package needs the idempotent path to run without a configured identity, move the identity check into the create/mount branch only. Left as is at slice depth because init always ends in a commit.
